title: Unofficial Emojiful 1.8.9 Port
description: An unofficial port of emojiful to 1.8.9
body:
An **unofficial** port of [Emojiful](https://modrinth.com/mod/emojiful) to 1.8.9

Emojiful adds in emoji to minecraft allowing you to send emojis with ease. It supports animated emojis too! It has emoji autocomplete and emoji selection to easily search all the available emojis. It works in signs, chat, name tags, and more.

Please check the gallery to see how it looks in game.

Some config options are not implemented, these ones are working:
- emoji_autocomplete
- emoji_selector
- enabled
- gifs
- short_emoji_replacement
- profanity filter (this only filters messages you send not ones you receive)

The configuration can be updated in-game so you don't need to restart.
